info.title: OpenWebPBX Tenant API
info.description: Email-verified tenant registration, isolated PBX self-provisioning and managed openwebpbx.com subdomains. Hosted services share the latest installed application files and one local instance database. This API does not create VMs or allocate carrier numbers. The hosted API is a separately deployed update; the original published 1.0.21 archives are unchanged. Self-hosted instances need a build containing this API and operator enablement. The API contract version is separate from server and Android package versions.

servers.description: OpenWeb hosted instance. Use normal HTTPS certificate verification.

get.summary: Check the API and registration status
get.description: Read safe public API/version metadata. No account details or credentials are returned. A disabled or uninstalled API returns 503.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.description: Valid requests return a generic response without confirming whether an email or slug is already registered. No PBX, active owner or API token is created before email verification. The email code expires after 30 minutes. Public signup is enabled according to instance policy.

example.message: If these details can be registered, a verification code will be emailed. Check your inbox and spam folder.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.summary: Verify email and activate the tenant
post.description: Redeem the single-use email code together with the original registration password. Returns the active tenant and a new bearer token once. Use POST; opening a link or GET request never activates an account.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.summary: Sign in as a verified tenant owner
post.description: A verified, enabled owner can obtain a fresh tenant-scoped token. Invalid credentials are reported generically. At most ten active tokens are allowed.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

get.description: Returns the current authenticated tenant and current token metadata. Token secrets are never returned by read endpoints.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.description: Verify the current account password and choose a new 12–72-byte password with a letter and a number. All previous owner API keys, including the key making this request, are revoked. Store the returned replacement before making another request. Does not change SIP, extension or phone-app passwords. Limit five password-change attempts per owner per ten minutes.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

get.description: Returns current revisions visible to this tenant, without credentials or encrypted payloads. Only shared, published starter templates explicitly approved by the instance administrator are available. They must have no trunks, outbound rules or additional settings. Configure your own provider after creating the PBX.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

get.description: Returns only this tenant's services. Each service is an isolated PBX on the shared instance, not a separate virtual machine.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.description: Creates an isolated PBX from the selected current template and atomically queues its requested managed subdomain. New public tenants start with one service. No paid provider connection or carrier DID is automatically enabled. Retry the exact same request with the same Idempotency-Key after a timeout.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value true when returning the original saved result for an identical idempotent request. Poll subdomain status for current readiness.

get.description: A valid UUID from another tenant is not disclosed. Existing service settings and the selected template revision remain attached to that service.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

get.description: Advisory local-instance check only. It does not reserve the name or query central DNS ownership. Reserved labels are refused. The custodian may assign a stable suffix when a requested name is held elsewhere; poll the owned service's actual status.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

parameters.name: label
parameters.description: Single lower-case label, 3–40 letters, numbers or hyphens.

get.description: DNS, trusted HTTPS and local transport preparation run in the background. url/admin_url remain null until the assigned name is verified ready. The requested name is not necessarily the final assigned hostname.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.description: Queue a managed subdomain on an owned active PBX service. Use a single label. Once queued or leased, the label cannot be silently renamed; changing it returns a conflict. Existing SIP realms and phone credentials are preserved. The custodian supports fifty names per instance, including reserved existing names.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present with value true when returning the original saved result for an identical idempotent request. Poll subdomain status for current readiness.

get.description: Returns up to the most recent 100 token metadata records, including revoked history, never raw token secrets. Use separate named keys for separate integrations.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.description: Returns the new token secret once. The default and maximum lifetime are ninety days. At most ten active tokens are allowed per tenant. This operation does not retain a replayable copy of the token; avoid blindly retrying it.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

delete.description: Immediately invalidate the selected owned token. The response is 204 with no body. Revoking the current token also ends its ability to make subsequent requests.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

post.description: Create a replacement secret and revoke the old secret atomically. Returns the replacement once; later read responses cannot recover it. Update the integration securely. Send an empty JSON object to use the default expiry.

X-Request-ID.description: Request reference for a support report.

slug.description: 3–40 letters, numbers or hyphens; starts and ends with a letter or number. Reserved labels are refused.

password.description: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, including a letter and a number. Never logged or returned.

accept_terms.description: Your client must present the project terms and privacy policy.

token.description: Single-use 30-minute verification code received by email.

password.description: The same password supplied when registering. Binds verification to your original registration.

current_password.description: Current account password; this additional verification is mandatory.

new_password.description: New account password: 12–72 UTF-8 bytes, including a letter and a number. Does not change SIP, extension or phone-app passwords.

access_token.description: Returned only by the operation which creates it; store securely.
New token secret. The old secret is invalidated when rotating.

template_uuid.description: Choose a currently visible published starter template.

subdomain.description: Optional single label. Defaults to your tenant slug. No scheme, dots, port or path.

hostname.description: Assigned hostname, which may have a stable collision suffix.

url.description: Trusted ready tenant HTTPS URL. Null until verified ready.

admin_url.description: Trusted ready tenant administration URL. Null until verified ready.

state.description: Current asynchronous worker state; inspect ready before advertising this address.

error_category.description: Safe category only; no DNS credentials or private worker diagnostics.

TenantBearer.description: A verified active tenant-owner token. Browser cookies do not authorize the API.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: A UUID unique to this intended operation. Retry the same JSON request with the same key. A changed request with a reused key is rejected.

ServiceId.name: service_uuid
ServiceId.description: An owned service UUID. Foreign resources are not disclosed.

TokenId.name: token_uuid
TokenId.description: A token belonging to this tenant.
